intro: This Product User Manual comprehensively details the Copernicus Land Monitoring Service (CLMS) Protected Areas (PA) product, offering harmonised land cover and land use information for Natura 2000 sites across Europe. It explains the product’s characteristics, including its hierarchical 59-class nomenclature, 0.5 ha Minimum Mapping Unit, and the methodology leveraging multi-temporal Sentinel-2 and Very High-Resolution imagery. The document outlines potential applications, user requirements, and thorough quality assessment procedures, providing essential guidance for scientists, regulators, and data engineers seeking to utilise this detailed European dataset for biodiversity monitoring and conservation efforts, establishing a new 2021 baseline.
